listing.name: BIGLOGISTICS
listing.aiSummary: Adds extremely large logistics ships, including welded Atlas variants and wide Prometheus models.

description: Introduces massive cargo vessels such as ten welded Atlases and an extremely wide Prometheus. Includes a normal Starliner variant with adjusted sensor ranges to prevent interaction issues.
